spec_match.rationale: The feature's only web-facing contract is silence — no completion, destination, or verdict signal after a download handoff — and the page demonstrates exactly that with real downloads, real listeners, and a probe table over every plausible surface.

interactive.rationale: Two real download triggers (Blob->a[download] and a data: link), a clear-able aria-live journal that distinguishes real events from timer-authored silence lines, and a re-runnable channel probe with control rows.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises a journal proving the page learns nothing past the click; the page delivers that including the listener-based silence proof.

edge_cases.rationale: Controls prove the probe technique works both directions; the journal covers both script-triggered and user-clicked link downloads; an unexpected event firing is surfaced loudly rather than swallowed.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6253669501763584, the HTML spec's downloading-resources section, and the sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the anchor/Blob mechanics the demo relies on, the absence of any download-outcome API with a working-control assertion, and records the enforcement itself as an honest manual/blocked contract; run live at 5 pass / 0 fail / 1 blocked.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: both triggers clicked, journal showed 4 real-event rows then 2 silence rows (no error/progress/load/loadend/abort in 2500 ms), probe reported 5/5 absent with controls holding, zero console errors, desktop 1280x2000 and 360x740 DPR3 screenshots read, 0px horizontal overflow at 360.

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js loaded deferred; showcaseTelemetry.assert wired for download-handoff-journalled, no-completion-signal (the honest not-observable branch), and no-download-outcome-api.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, button background+color set together, 44px min-height controls, tables in overflow-x scrollers, no static code-card.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons and a real link, journal is role=log with aria-live=polite and labelled by the section heading, outputs use aria-live, table has caption and th scope, silence rows carry a textual 'written by a timer' prefix so the distinction is not colour-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation and 1280x2000 desktop: no horizontal overflow (0px), controls wrap, tap targets >=44px, journal scrolls internally. No class is excluded — downloads work on both.

openQuestions.title: Observe the enforced flow once on a real managed profile
openQuestions.detail: The page honestly labels the downloads-UI outcome ("Failed - Local download blocked") as manual observation quoted from generated_resources.grd. When a managed Chrome 155 profile with a File-download DLP rule using Enforce cloud storage is available, observe the shelf string, chrome://downloads description, and the corp-drive upload once and cite the observation date on the page.

guidanceConsulted.query: aria-live status log region for async events
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use live regions sparingly and centrally for updates not tied to focus; prefer native elements and explicit label association; style :focus-visible explicitly.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: One polite role=log journal per page plus polite output elements; all controls are native button/a elements inheriting the design system's focus styles; no ARIA where native semantics suffice.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP run: journal populated via appended li rows in the single live region; unlabelled-control scan returned [].

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible file download links and user feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Download links need clear names stating what will happen, and feedback about the action's result must be honest and perceivable non-visually.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The data: link's text names the action and target; result feedback is delivered as text rows in the live-region journal, and the page states explicitly when no result is knowable rather than implying success.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Journal transcript from CDP run shows the silence rows announced in the live region.

summary: The observable-edge demo for a policy with no web API: it earns 'the page learns nothing' by triggering real downloads with listeners attached and journalling the silence, with control rows keeping the absence proof honest. Verified interactively in headless Chromium 141 over CDP with a clean console and both viewport classes screenshotted.
